name: academy.jasonlau/classes
title: Jason Lau Academy
description: Vibe coding classes for teens in Hong Kong: class info, AI tool age limits, guides, enquiries.

tools.name: get_class_info
tools.description: Facts about Jason Lau's vibe coding (AI app building) classes for teens in Hong Kong: who they are for, what teens build, the tools used, the teaching language and how to enquire. Quotes only what jasonlau.academy publishes. Fees, dates and venue are NOT published: say so and suggest enquiring; never guess them.

tools.name: get_ai_tool_age_limits
tools.description: Minimum ages, rules for under 18s and Hong Kong availability for 12 AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Replit, Cursor and more), from Jason Lau's guide checked against each provider's terms in November 2026. Optionally filter by tool name. Terms change, so tell parents to check the provider's page.

tool.description: Part of a tool name, for example "chatgpt" or "copilot". Leave out for every tool.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Lists Jason Lau's guides and writing for parents of teens learning to build with AI, with URLs and one line summaries, in English and Traditional Chinese.

language.description: Guides in English (en), Traditional Chinese (zh-HK) or both (all).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches jasonlau.academy (class information, the AI tool age limits guide, site facts, and guides and writing for parents, in English and Traditional Chinese) by keywords. Returns ids, titles and URLs; use fetch with an id to read the full text.

query.description: Keywords in English or Chinese, for example "age limits chatgpt" or "安全".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of one search result from jasonlau.academy, with its title, URL and metadata. Pass an id exactly as search returned it.

id.description: An id from search, for example "class-info" or "writing:python-or-vibe-coding".

tools.name: send_enquiry
tools.description: Passes a class enquiry to Jason Lau by email, the same way as the enquiry form on jasonlau.academy. Use only when a parent (or a student aged 16 or over) asks you to, after they have given every field and explicitly agreed that you send their details to Jason. Never send for a student under 16 contacting Jason themselves; ask them to have a parent get in touch. Jason replies with dates and fees. Set consent_to_email to true only when the person has said yes to sending.

contact_name.description: Name of the person Jason should reply to.

contact.description: Email address, Telegram username (like @name) or phone number with country code (like +852).

message.description: What the teen is interested in or wants to build, and any questions, in the person's own words.

consent_to_email.description: Must be true: the person agreed to send these details to Jason by email.
